★Request
Show Epiphaneia (Summer Jersey)
Hold on! I'm heading up to you right now!
(Whistle... BANG! BANG! BANG!)
Huh? What do you mean 'no', why—
—Ah, that look on your face!!
? What are you talking about? Whoa—

Of course!
I can catch one person as many times as it takes!

I catch my breath at the sight unfolding before my eyes.
She always radiates an explosive brilliance that makes my heart pound—

There's only one choice!
Jump down to me, Trainer! I swear I'll catch you!

! I see, there's a pack of wild dogs...
In that case—

My existence brought you happiness—
of course I'd want to see that again and again!!
Then I'll come to you!! —...Over that way!
With that in mind, I psyched myself up and looked all around, but...
From below the cliff, an unmistakable voice echoed up.

Even when we first met, I felt it telling me 'This way!'
I can hear it right now too! There's no way I'm wrong...!
Show me more and more of it from now on!

I'm relieved she found me, but I can't put her in danger.
Since I can't make a sound, I frantically shake my head and cross my arms into an X.

Ever since then, I've wanted to see all kinds of expressions from you, Trainer!
I just know there are so many looks where we can share the exact same feeling!

I want to make you smile like that over and over again.
Tell me, Trainer!

The one from before, when you said, 'I'm really happy we can spend time together like this'!
Yes! I got to see it again!
WOOOOOAAAAAHHH!! Hang on, Trainer—!!
A comet shining with singular brilliance in the center of a star-filled sky.
WOOOOO!! LAST SPUUUUUUURT!!

There's no time to hesitate—no, any hesitation vanished the moment she spread her arms.
I promised to follow her until the day the world is filled with destiny.
What?! Over that way... how do you even know?!

Cold, unpleasant sweat drips down my cheek. The distance between me and the pack is shrinking, and
it's certainly not my imagination—I'm being cornered like prey.
Hey—what are you feeling right now?
Even without fireworks...!!

Any question of how she found me is blown away in an instant.
'I knew it'—she heard it.

Yeah. I was sure they were with you, but...
Maybe we should go look for them.

Don't worry!
I won't—I won't ever let go of my destiny!
Huh? Trainer? Where did you go?

I see...!
So that's why I was drawn so powerfully to that expression!

The fortunate thing is that she never leaves me behind,
and always brings me along with her.
I reflect on it once more. Both back then and now, without a doubt—

The sound of fireworks...!
Come to think of it, the fireworks festival is tonight.
(Grrrrrr...)

Scooping me up into her arms without effort, Epiphaneia dashes into the night.
Without hesitation, straight ahead—

From now on—she'll probably keep dragging me along. There'll be plenty of hardship, too.
Still, yes... even so. I find myself wanting to follow her wherever she goes.
This face... The way you look right now is what I love the most!!

Kicking off the ground without hesitation, she dives in.
—Everything seemed to move in slow motion.
(Grrrrrr!!)

The brilliance of the stars I saw on that summer night burned into my heart,
and surely, it will never fade away.

Your playful face, your surprised face, your embarrassed face. I've come to love them all!
But after all—
—Gotcha!
Look!! The stars are so beautiful!!
Just as I thought! You were here after all, Trainer!
—Found you!!
Come, Trainer! Come to me!!
(Snort, snort... Grrr...)
What did you say?! Trainer hasn't come back yet?!
Are you hurt, Trainer?

Trainer!!
That face full of happiness, and all your other expressions too!

Epiphaneia was in top shape even at the summer training camp.
Guided by the voice of destiny, she'd suddenly go for long-distance swims or start climbing mountains.

Of course I know!
Because, Trainer—you are my destiny!!

Mmmgh—!!
The mountain air feels so good, Trainer!
—!! That's the face of happiness!!

Since she was getting such great results from training in the wild outdoors,
if only I could find a place where she could build her strength even more effectively—

To train my leg strength and stamina, of course!
The voice of destiny told me to push the limits, too!

Embarrassingly enough, I ended up completely lost in the forest.
My phone had no signal, leaving me with no way to call for help. What should I do—
